sections.title: Settings
sections.description: The source file, the stack corrections, detector and estimator settings, the parameter plane with its gates, cross N&B and the actions.
Compute the maps, write them out, explore them or go on to the next step.

buttons.label: Run
buttons.description: Compute N, B, ε and n of every detector window with the stack corrections, detector corrections and moment smoothing set below, in the background. Nothing is recomputed when nothing changed.

buttons.label: Add N&B to HDF5
buttons.description: Add the N&B columns of every window to the imaging HDF5 of the pipeline; when none is remembered a file is asked for.

buttons.label: Save container
buttons.description: Write the N&B table as an nb artifact into the container beside the photon file (the Qt tool did this when it closed).

buttons.label: ndX
buttons.description: Explore the per-pixel table in ndX, the shared live dataset. A Back button returns to the maps.

buttons.label: Next
buttons.description: Remember the file and the HDF5 and go to the next analysis step. Only available inside the Imaging Tools pipeline.

sections.description: The demo scan and the analog detector calibration.

buttons.label: Load demo
buttons.description: Write and open a simulated scan whose answer is known: monomers on the left, dimers at the same intensity on the right, and compute it. The first time it simulates the scan.

buttons.label: Calibrate analog
buttons.description: With a static-gradient calibration file loaded and run: fit variance against mean and set the analog gain S and offset.

sections.label: TTTR file
sections.placeholder: pick a file, drop one here, or load from the database
sections.description: Confocal photon-stream file (PTU/HT3/...) with line and frame markers; N&B needs many frames of the same field. The detector windows decide which windows are analysed. Press Enter to select a typed path.
Pick the photon file from disk or from the database.

buttons.label: Browse
buttons.description: Browse for a photon imaging file on disk.

buttons.label: Database
buttons.description: Load a dataset registered in the database; the database resolves it to a local file wherever its object store keeps the data.

sections.label: View
sections.description: Bring any map or plot tab forward, also when the row of tabs is wider than the window.

sections.label: Detector window
sections.description: The detector window shown in the maps. Every window is computed and written; this only chooses which one is drawn. The windows come from the Detectors tab (or the Imaging Tools setup step); without any, the channel-0 window is used.
What was computed and, once gates exist, what they select.

sections.label: Subtract
sections.description: Removed from every frame before the moments are taken: the frame mean (whole-frame intensity changes), the pixel mean over frames (immobile structure) or a sliding box average (slow drifts and immobile structure together). The box is set below.

sections.label: Add back
sections.description: Added back after subtracting. B = σ²/⟨k⟩ divides by the mean, so a subtraction must be followed by adding a mean back — the total mean or the pixel mean — or B loses its meaning.

sections.label: Box (px)
sections.description: Lateral edge of the moving-average box (both axes). An even box is centred one pixel early, as the reference implementation does.

sections.label: Box (frames)
sections.description: Temporal length of the moving-average box. It must be long compared with the number fluctuations you want to keep, or the subtraction removes the signal N&B measures.

sections.label: Background
sections.description: Constant counts per pixel dwell subtracted at the end (dark counts, scattered light).

sections.label: Detrend segments
sections.description: Bleaching correction: fit a straight line to every pixel within each of this many time segments, subtract it and add the pixel mean back. 0 switches it off. A bleaching decay inflates σ² and therefore B; several short lines follow the decay where one cannot.

sections.label: Dead time (ns)
sections.description: Detector dead time. Counts are corrected as k/(1 − k·τ/T) before the moments; it needs the pixel dwell T below. 0 switches the correction off.

sections.label: Pixel dwell (µs)
sections.description: Time the beam spends on one pixel; only used by the dead-time correction.

sections.label: Gain S
sections.description: Analog detectors only: counts per photon, from a static-gradient calibration (toolbar: Calibrate analog). 1 for a photon-counting detector.

sections.label: Offset
sections.description: Analog detectors only: the signal of zero photons, from the same calibration. 0 for a photon-counting detector.

sections.label: Read variance σ₀²
sections.description: Analog detectors only: variance of the dark signal (measure it with the shutter closed). 0 for a photon-counting detector.

sections.label: Shape factor γ
sections.description: Observation-volume shape factor. ε is divided and n multiplied by γ. 1 reports ε and n as Digman et al. define them; 0.3536 (1/√8, 3-D Gaussian) gives the γ-corrected values of the reference implementation.

sections.label: Moment smoothing
sections.description: Smooth the mean and standard-deviation maps before forming B and N: a box of Radius pixels, a disk of radius Radius−1, or a Gaussian of σ = Radius/2. Trades resolution for a less noisy brightness map.

sections.label: Radius
sections.description: Size of the moment smoothing. 1 or less switches the smoothing off.

sections.label: Median filter (ε, n)
sections.description: Pass the ε and n maps through a 3×3 median filter, which removes single hot pixels without blurring edges.

sections.label: Plane x
sections.description: Horizontal axis of the parameter plane. Intensity ⟨k⟩ against brightness is the classic N&B plot: at equal intensity, monomers and oligomers separate by brightness.

sections.label: Plane y
sections.description: Vertical axis of the parameter plane (mean, B, N, epsilon or n).

sections.label: Bins
sections.description: Bins per axis of the parameter-plane histogram.

sections.label: Log counts
sections.description: Show the parameter-plane histogram on a logarithmic count scale, so a small population stays visible next to the dominant one.

sections.title: Gate regions
sections.description: Regions drawn on the parameter plane. The pixels whose (x, y) fall inside are selected and shown in the Gated pixels map — a brightness population, back on the image. Tick to include, ~ for everything outside.

buttons.label: Clear gates
buttons.description: Drop every gate region; all pixels are selected again.

sections.description: Drop every gate region.

sections.label: Cross with
sections.description: Second detector window for cross N&B with the displayed one. B_cross = cov/√(⟨a⟩⟨b⟩) has no −1: shot noise is uncorrelated between detectors, so B_cross ≈ 0 means the two labels move independently and B_cross > 0 that they move together.
